# Earnings and Filings Teardown

⚠️ **Finance warning / Avertissement finance** : informational only, not investment advice. A faithful brief of what a company reported is not a view on what its stock will do: reported results can still precede losses, there is a real risk of loss in any investment, and no brief here is a promise of return. Curated by Skill Harbor: the earnings and filings teardown skill at the root of andreworia/claude-finance-skills. Use it when the office of the CFO needs the financially material substance of a public disclosure distilled fast and traceably: a competitor or your own 10-K, 10-Q or 8-K has landed, an earnings call transcript needs to become KPIs, guidance and risks, or a benchmarking workstream needs clean sourced inputs from a filing. The output is a one page structured brief covering reported KPIs, segment and geography revenue, guidance and outlook changes, key risk factors, capital allocation actions and notable accounting or one time items, where every extracted figure carries a source traceability tag naming the document, section and page or paragraph, and each section closes with a so what for the CFO line. The ten step method identifies the document and period first, pulls the income statement with period over period changes computed, extracts segment and geography revenue and confirms the segments tie to consolidated revenue, reads the MD&A for stated drivers while keeping management narrative separate from inference, captures guidance as a direction against prior...
